facts.fact: The authority's 2023-2026 strategic plan describes the APD, created by law 2017-020, as acting to authorise and control all processing of personal data and to recruit staff; the plan carries the year 2023 only, no day (published date used).
The plan states it is placed under the sign of the entry into force of law 2017-020 on personal data protection; no commencement date is given (published date 2023 used).
